flows.name: Authenticated Eve assistant
steps: Open the corrected frontend preview as an authenticated Alleato user
flows.expectedOutcome: Eve responds through the authenticated proxy, enforces project scope, performs no denied effect, and performs the approved effect exactly once with a durable receipt.

checks: The Alleato AI surface renders inside the existing production shell
The conversation, tool state, approval controls, and result remain readable
No MKH or standalone-template branding appears

claims.description: The existing Alleato /ai surface sends an authenticated first turn through the transplanted Eve runtime.
An authorized project read succeeds and an unauthorized project request is rejected.
A denied write produces zero effects and one approved write produces exactly one persisted effect and receipt.
The final source comparison accounts for all completed AI Tools Verification product changes and excludes unfinished temporary work.
